results.title: Cixi, Zhejiang — Grokipedia
results.content: Cixi, Zhejiang Cixi is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of Ningbo in northeastern Zhejiang province, China. [1] Spanning 1,361 square kilometers with a population of approximately 1.9 million in 2025, Cixi functions as a vital industrial and commercial hub within the Yangtze River Delta's Greater Shanghai Economic Circle.

results.content: Cixi, formerly romanized as Tzeki, is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of the sub-provincial city of Ningbo, in northeastern Zhejiang province, China.

results.title: Cixi, Zhejiang - Wikiwand
results.content: Cixi, formerly romanized as Tzeki, is a county-level city under the jurisdiction of the sub-provincial city of Ningbo, in northeastern Zhejiang province, China. As of the 2020 census, its population was 1,829,488. Its urban agglomeration built-up area, largely contiguous with Cixi plus the county-level city of Yuyao, had 3,083,520 inhabitants.
